title: House leaders deny talks of postponing 2028 polls
summary: The denials come after VP Sara Duterte's spokesperson floats a 'no-election' scenario in 2028

blocks.text: LOWER CHAMBER. The House of Representatives Session Hall.
The denials come after VP Sara Duterte's spokesperson floats a 'no-election' scenario in 2028

MANILA, Philippines – House leaders refuted a claim made by Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Paolo Panelo that there have been talks in the lower chamber of postponing or deferring the 2028 elections.

“There is absolutely no basis for claims that the House leadership is planning to postpone the 2028 elections or to extend the terms of incumbent officials. There is no such a plan or proposal that is being pushed by the House leadership,” Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez said on Thursday, November 19.

“I urge all parties to refrain from spreading unverified and baseless claims that only serve to sow confusion and undermine public trust in our democratic institutions. This is nothing but a figment of someone’s imagination,” House suffrage committee chairperson Zia Alonto Adiong added.
Their denials came after Panelo said in a Bilyonaryo News Channel interview that Duterte had received information about a “no-elections” scenario for the 2028 polls.

Adiong, who speaks on behalf of the prosecution in Duterte’s impeachment trial, and prosecutor Joel Chua believe that the Vice President’s camp was floating the “no-el” scenario to divert the public’s attention from the ongoing Senate proceedings.

blocks.text: “It would be better if they just answer the allegations here, instead of making up numerous issues to draw away the attention (from the trial),” Chua said. – Rappler.com
